taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-13, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1340.2 | 1.08 | 1.08
2 | 2148.3 | 1.38 | 2.46
3 | 5322.7 | 1.26 | 3.72
4 | 18475.7 | 0.33 | 4.05
5 | 19320.3 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as AKH-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station T-13, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Groundwater Site Note: Station T-13 (Area T)**

**Layer Sequence Summary:**
Station T-13 presents a 5-layer geoelectric section characterized by monotonically increasing resistivities with depth:
- Layer 1: 1,340.2 Ω·m (thickness: 1.08 m, depth: 0–1.08 m)
- Layer 2: 2,148.3 Ω·m (thickness: 1.38 m, depth: 1.08–2.46 m)
- Layer 3: 5,322.7 Ω·m (thickness: 1.26 m, depth: 2.46–3.72 m)
- Layer 4: 18,475.7 Ω·m (thickness: 0.33 m, depth: 3.72–4.05 m)
- Layer 5: 19,320.3 Ω·m (basement, depth: >4.05 m)

**Curve Type Evaluation:**
Because resistivities strictly increase across all successive triplets ($r_1 < r_2 < r_3$, $r_2 < r_3 < r_4$, and $r_3 < r_4 < r_5$), the curve is strictly **AAA-type** (or **A-type**). The archival classification of **AKH-type** is incorrect and does not fit the modeled layer resistivity sequence. Drilling operations should anticipate very resistive bedrock below 3.7 m.

{"curve_type_stated": "AKH", "label_issue_flagged": true}
